name: Are there any fees or penalties if I cancel my listing agreement early?

mainEntity.name: Are there any fees or penalties if I cancel my listing agreement early?

acceptedAnswer.text: With a 'Cancel Anytime Listing Agreement,' there are generally no fees or penalties for early cancellation, provided no acceptable offer has been received and you are not in a pre-negotiated termination period. The intent is to offer maximum flexibility to the seller. However, you might still be responsible for pre-paid marketing expenses directly incurred by the agent if specified in the contract. It's crucial to review the specific terms with Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution to understand any such provisions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typically, there are no fees for early cancellation with this agreement, but review your specific contract for any clauses regarding pre-paid marketing expenses.
